How to set up OAuth Login

Create a classic Connected App in your Salesforce org — takes ~3 minutes, done once:

  1. In your org → Setup → Quick Find: App Manager
  2. Click New Connected App (not "New External Client App")
    Tip: If you only see External Client App, go to Setup → External Client Apps → Settings → Connected Apps → New Connected App
  3. Fill in: App Name → SF Tools, Contact Email
  4. Check "Enable OAuth Settings" → Callback URL — add both lines:
    https://salesforcetools.in/ http://localhost/
  5. OAuth Scopes → Add Full Access (full) + Perform requests at any time (refresh_token, offline_access)
  6. Check "Enable PKCE" → Uncheck "Require Secret for Web Server Flow" + Uncheck "Require Secret for Refresh Token Flow" → Click Save
  7. Wait 2–10 minutes for Salesforce to activate, then go to Manage Consumer Details → copy the Consumer Key
  8. Back in SF Tools → Custom tab → paste your org URL → click Login with Salesforce
✅ Always use Custom tab: Enter your exact org URL (e.g. https://yourorg.my.salesforce.com) so Salesforce finds your Connected App in the right org. Production orgs use login.salesforce.com, sandboxes use test.salesforce.com.
🔴 Getting OAUTH_APPROVAL_ERROR_GENERIC?
1. Check Callback URL in Connected App exactly matches https://salesforcetools.in/ (with trailing slash)
2. Salesforce takes 2–10 min after Save — wait and retry
3. Go to your Connected App → Manage → set OAuth Policy to "All users may self-authorize"
4. Ensure your profile has "Approve Uninstalled Connected Apps" permission

Privacy & Data

Last updated: May 2026

What We Collect

Google Account (if signed in)
Name, email, profile picture — to identify your account
Salesforce Org Nicknames
Only the label and instance URL you choose to save — never access tokens or passwords
Usage Data
Which tools you use, how often — to improve the product (anonymous)
Feedback
Name, email, message — only when you submit the feedback form

What We Never Store

Salesforce access tokens or session IDs
Passwords of any kind
Your Apex code or SOQL queries
Data from your Salesforce org records
Credit card or payment information (handled by Razorpay)

Third-Party Services

Cloudflare Hosts the website and worker. Standard server access logs per Cloudflare policy.
Google Sign-in authentication only. We do not share your data with Google beyond authentication.
Anthropic / Groq / Gemini Your Apex code is sent to AI providers to generate test classes. Not stored by us.
Razorpay Handles payments. We never see your card details.
Web3Forms Receives feedback form submissions. Governed by their privacy policy.

Data Retention

Your account data is kept as long as your account is active. Sessions expire after 30 days of inactivity. Anonymous usage data is retained for up to 90 days. You can delete all your data at any time.

Delete Your Account & Data

Permanently deletes your profile, saved orgs, and all associated data from our servers. This cannot be undone.

Contact: For any privacy questions or data requests, email sftools19@gmail.com

Frequently Asked Questions
Is SF Tools completely free?

Yes — all browser-based tools are 100% free with no account needed. Org-connected tools (Apex Execute, Debug Logs, REST Explorer, etc.) require connecting your Salesforce org via OAuth.

Do you store my Salesforce data or credentials?

No. Your org credentials and data never leave your browser. OAuth tokens are stored only in your browser's localStorage. API calls go through our proxy worker which forwards your request to Salesforce — we don't log or store any response data.

Does it work offline?

Yes — all browser-based tools (Package Builder, Code Diff, SOQL Builder, Cron Builder, Formatter) work offline once the page is loaded. Org-connected tools require an internet connection to talk to Salesforce.

Which Salesforce orgs are supported?

Any Salesforce org with API access — Production, Sandbox, Developer Edition, and Scratch Orgs. You connect via standard OAuth 2.0 so no password is shared with SF Tools.

Is SF Tools affiliated with Salesforce, Inc.?

No. SF Tools is an independent project built by a Salesforce developer, for Salesforce developers. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Salesforce, Inc.

Frequently Asked Questions

      
      

        

          I already have a Claude API key — should I still get Pro?
          
        

        
Probably not — and we're being honest here. If you have your own Anthropic API key, all 24+ SF Tools features (including the AI Test Generator and AI Agent) already work for free. You pay Anthropic directly at their per-token rates. Pro is for developers who don't want to create an Anthropic account, manage API keys, or deal with per-call billing. If that sounds like you, Pro makes sense. If you already have a key, save your money.

      

      

        

          What is a Pro token and how does it work?
          
        

        
A Pro token is a unique access key tied to your subscription. Instead of providing your own Anthropic API key, you paste the token once in SF Tools → AI Agent → SF Tools Pro tab. All AI calls route through our proxy and count against your plan's monthly quota — no Anthropic account needed.

      

      

        

          What happens when I hit my monthly quota?
          
        

        
AI calls (Test Generator & AI Agent) will be paused until your quota resets at the start of your next billing cycle. All 24+ free tools (Debug Logs, SOQL, REST Explorer, Org Limits, etc.) continue to work normally — they don't use your AI quota at all.

      

      

        

          Can I use the token on multiple devices?
          
        

        
Yes. Paste your token on any device or browser and it works instantly. For Team plans, the entire team shares one token — the monthly quota is pooled across all sessions using that token.

      

      

        

          What is the refund policy?
          
        

        
Full refund within 48 hours of purchase if you haven't used more than 10 AI calls. Email support@salesforcetools.in with your order ID and we'll process it promptly — no questions asked.

        MCP Server
      

      
Salesforce MCP Server
for Claude Desktop

      
Connect Claude Desktop to your live Salesforce org. Ask questions in plain English — Claude calls the right tool, runs real SOQL queries, and returns structured results. Powered by the Model Context Protocol.

    


    


      
      

        

          
        

        

          
What is the Model Context Protocol?

          
MCP is an open standard by Anthropic that lets AI assistants like Claude Desktop call external tools in a structured, type-safe way. This server exposes 17 Salesforce tools — the same underlying API calls used by SF Tools' browser-based org pages — so Claude can query your org, run Apex, inspect flows, check permissions, and more without you writing a single SOQL query.

        

      


      
      


        
        

          

            
            Setup (3 steps)
          

          

            

              
1

              

                
Install dependencies

                npm install @modelcontextprotocol/sdk zod
                
Requires Node.js 18+ with fetch built-in

              

            

            

              
2

              

                
Save the server script

                
Copy the sf-mcp.mjs source below and save it to a folder, e.g. ~/sf-mcp/sf-mcp.mjs

              

            

            

              
3

              

                
Add to Claude Desktop config

                
Open Claude → Settings → Developer → Edit Config and paste the JSON on the right. Replace the placeholder values with your real session ID and instance URL.

              

            

          

          

            🔑 Getting your credentials: Connect your org in SF Tools, then open the browser console and run SF.sessionId and SF.instanceUrl. Or use sf org display in the Salesforce CLI.
          

        


        
        

          

            

              
              claude_desktop_config.json
            

            
          

          
          
After saving the config, restart Claude Desktop. You should see a 🔌 indicator showing salesforce is connected.

Privacy Policy

    
Last updated: May 5, 2026  ·  Effective: May 5, 2026


    


      

        
1. Who We Are

        
SF Tools ("we", "us", "our") is an independent developer toolkit available at salesforcetools.in. We are not affiliated with or endorsed by Salesforce, Inc. This Privacy Policy explains how we handle your information when you use our service.

      


      

        
2. Data We Collect

        
Free tools (no account required): We collect no personal data. All tool operations run entirely in your browser. Your Salesforce OAuth access token is stored only in your browser's sessionStorage and is never transmitted to our servers.

        
SF Tools Pro (paid plan): When you purchase a Pro subscription, Razorpay (our payment processor) collects your name, email address, and payment details. We receive only a payment confirmation and your email address to issue your Pro token. We do not store credit card or bank information.

        
AI features (own API key): If you use your own Anthropic API key, your key is stored in your browser's localStorage only and is sent directly to Anthropic's API — it never passes through our servers.

        
AI features (Pro token): Your org queries are relayed through our Cloudflare Worker proxy to Anthropic's API. We do not log or store the content of your queries.

      


      

        
3. Salesforce Data

        
When you connect your Salesforce org, your OAuth access token is stored in sessionStorage (cleared when you close the tab). All Salesforce API calls are made directly from your browser to Salesforce's servers. We do not see, store, or process any data from your Salesforce org.

      


      

        
4. Cookies & Local Storage

        
We do not use tracking cookies. We use browser localStorage to save your preferences (dark mode, API key, selected model) locally on your device. This data never leaves your browser.

      


      

        
5. Third-Party Services

        
    
          
  • Razorpay — payment processing for Pro subscriptions. Governed by Razorpay's Privacy Policy.
    • 
          
  • Anthropic Claude API — powers AI Test Generator and AI Agent features. Your queries may be processed per Anthropic's Privacy Policy.
    • 
          
  • Google Fonts — loads Inter and DM Serif Display fonts. Google may log font requests per their privacy policy.
    • 
          
  • Cloudflare — hosts this website and our proxy worker. Standard server access logs may be retained per Cloudflare's policy.
    • 
        

      


      

        
6. Data Retention

        
We do not maintain a user database. Pro subscription records (email + token) are retained for the duration of the subscription to enable access. Payment records are retained by Razorpay per their legal obligations.

      


      

        
7. Your Rights (GDPR / CCPA)

        
If you are located in the EU, UK, or California, you have the right to request deletion of any personal data we hold (your email address associated with a Pro subscription). To exercise this right, email us at support@salesforcetools.in and we will delete your record within 30 days.

      


      

        
8. Security

        
Since we store minimal data and all Salesforce operations run in your browser, the attack surface is extremely small. Our Cloudflare Worker proxy does not log request content. API keys and tokens are never stored server-side.

      


      

        
9. Children's Privacy

        
SF Tools is intended for professional use and is not directed at children under 13. We do not knowingly collect data from children.

      


      

        
10. Changes to This Policy

        
We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Changes will be posted on this page with an updated effective date.

      


      

        
11. Contact

        
For privacy questions or data deletion requests: support@salesforcetools.in
